verdict: ROAS surging at 6x; purchase momentum is real but needs watching.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns delivered a 6.03x return on ad spend over the last 28 days on $1,344.60 in spend, and the most recent 7-day window shows that return nearly doubling compared to the prior week. Purchases also rose 22% week over week, though the last three days came in softer, so we're watching closely before reading the weekly pop as a sustained trend. Revenue in this period has been driven in part by large single orders on specific days, which can swing the ROAS figure; we're monitoring basket consistency to confirm the floor holds. One campaign is currently carrying the majority of spend, so we're preparing additional creative to reduce concentration risk heading into the next period. Google Business Profile activity dipped this week, and we're keeping an eye on local search engagement alongside the paid performance.

improvement in return on ad spend, this week vs. the prior week

watch_item.issue: One campaign is accounting for 52% of total spend, creating exposure if the creative wears out.
watch_item.fix: Additional creative is being developed now to diversify the campaign mix before fatigue sets in.
